publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Echinomycin (Ech) is a small-molecule inhibitor of hypoxia-inducible factor-1 DNA-binding activity, which plays a crucial role in the regulation of ovarian functions in mammals. The present study was designed to test the hypothesis that hypoxia-inducible factor (HIF)-1alpha-mediated proliferation cell nuclear antigen (PCNA) expressions contributed to the follicular development in the ovary of postnatal rats. Through the histological examination, the decrease of growing and antral follicle numbers was found in Ech-treated group. And then PCNA mRNA and protein expressions were detected by real time PCR and western blot and the significant decreases of these were found. While the levels of HIF-1alpha mRNA and protein expression were no obviously changes. Further analysis of HIF-1 binding activity found Ech significantly inhibited HIF-1 binding activities in Ech-treated group. These results indicated Ech inhibites follicular development though HIF-1alpha signaling pathway and HIF-1alpha plays an important role in this developmental process in PCNA-dependent manner. Granulosa cell culture experiment further identified the above findings. Taken together, these results demonstrated this HIF-1alpha-mediated PCNA expression is one of the important mechanisms regulating the ovarian follicular development in mammals.

articleTitle: The Application Value of Background Suppression Diffusion-Weighted Imaging (DWIBS) in Preoperative Staging of Rectal Cancer
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Purpose: To explore the applied value of magnetic resonance background suppression diffusion weighted imaging (DWIBS) for preoperative staging of rectal cancer. Methods: 39 cases of rectal cancer, which were confirmed by colonoscopy, underwent DWIBS before the surgery. The data was divided into three groups (T2, T3, T4) on the basis of pathological results about T-stage of rectal cancer. The relative signal intensity and the ADC values of the tumor were measured, the length, perimeter and thickness of the lesion were examined on DWIBS sequence. Analyze the difference of every index among groups and do correlative analysis with T stage. The NM staging was done by DWIBS. Then, the results were compared with the results of pathological NM staging and determine the accuracy, specificity and sensitivity of DWIBS NM staging. Results: The perimeter and thickness of the lesion had significant difference (P 0.05) among groups. On diagnosing metastatic lymph nodes the overall accuracy rate of N staging was 84.61%, For N0 stage, the accuracy was 100%, the sensitivity was 85.71%, the specificity was 83.33%. For N1 stage, the accuracy was 77.78% the diagnostic sensitivity was 70.00%, the specificity was 89.66%. For N2 stage, the accuracy was 66.67%, the sensitivity was 100%, the specificity was 80.65%. 6 cases of distant metastasis were correctly diagnosed by DWIBS. Conclusion: DWIBS is sensitivity and accuracy in NM staging of rectal cancer. It is an effective method to show the metastatic lymph node and distant metastasis. DWIBS can clear display rectal cancer, and has certain application value in T staging. Combined with conventional MRI sequence would help to improve the accuracy of the T stage.

articleTitle: Research on the Effective Implementation Strategy of Flipped Classroom
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The flipped classroom makes full use of information technology, adheres to the first learning and late teaching, takes the learner as the center, advocates autonomous learning, and focuses on classroom interaction, communication, cooperation and inquiry. On the basis of analyzing the origin and development of flipped classroom, this paper summarizes the main features of flipped classroom compared with traditional teaching. At last, the paper points out that we should establish a new teaching concept, improve the implementation of the flipped classroom, and pay more attention to cultivating the students' learning skills to promote the effective implementation of flipped classroom.

Author Keywords: flipped classroom teaching video implementation strategy

articleTitle: Digital Image Processing Teaching Auxiliary System Based on MATLAB Graphical User Interface
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to design and develop an interactive dynamic simulation platform for digital image processing teaching. This platform is constructed and implemented by the hierarchical design. The user interfaces of platform are build by the graphical user interface controls of MATLAB and user operations are responded by writing callback functions. The abstract teaching contents and processing procedure are interpreted by image comparison and animation demonstration. On the platform, users can realize the learning and understanding of knowledge through interactions with operation interface. Moreover, utilizing the secondary development function of platform, students can consolidate and expand their study and application. The practice shows that the simulation platform, as a supplementary teaching method, can enhance students' interest and perceptual cognition and effectively improve the teaching and learning effect in the classroom.

articleTitle: The Model of PK/PD for Danhong Injection Analyzed by Least Square Method
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The correlation of PK/PD for Danhong Injection (DHI) was investigated by the least square method in a rat model of cerebral ischemia/reperfusion. [Methods] Sprague-Dawley rats were randomly divided into 4 equal groups (each n = 6) (sham group), cerebral IR damage alone (model group), IR model treated with DHI (treatment group), and IR model treated with nimodipine (positive group). The drugs concentration of Danshensu (DSS) and Hydroxysafflor yellow A (HSA) in Plasma were measured by HPLC at 5, 15, 30, 60, 120, 180, 240, and 360 min. The levels of IL-1β in Plasma were measured by method of enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay. Curves were fit using nonlinear least squares methods. The results showed that levels of IL-1β were decreased after 60, 120, 180, 240, and 360 min (P <; 0.05) and infarct volume (%) was reduced compared to the model group (P <; 0.01). Regression equation of DSS and HSA showed that IL-1β and DSS were better fit than those for HSA. DHI reduces inflammation in cerebral ischemic injury. And the DSS in DHI mainly reduce IL-1β in a rat model of cerebral ischemia/reperfusion.

articleTitle: Research on the Virtual Moving Object Recognition Based on the SSVEP-BCI
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In this study, a brain-computer interface (BCI) paradigm based on steady-state visually evoked potentials (SSVEP) has been presented to seek the effects of the movement of the stimulus targets on classification accuracy in virtual environment, which was seldom noticed previously. Several paths including fixed, up/down, broken line, random path, and different speeds were set for searching performances' difference. Experiment results show that the accuracy of this novel paradigm is slightly lower than that of the conventional non-moving paradigms but it might be more practical. And different moving path brought about different performance, especially, crisscross's times was important to subject's judgment, more crisscross with flickering more erroneous judgment occur. It should be a base of target recognition in real environment.

articleTitle: The Effects of Rehmannia Glutinosa Polysaccharide on Immune Function of Mice
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: [Objective] To study the effects of Rehmannia glutinosa polysaccharide (RGP) on immune function of mice. [Method] Mice divided into four groups. Delayed-type hypersensitivity (DTH) models induced by Sheep red blood cell (SRBC) were applied for evaluation of the cellular immune function of mice. Except the control group, the mice were fed with the extract of RGP at the Low, Middle and High doses. The experiment period was 25 days. The swelling of mouse toes were measured, and the spleen and thymus were harvested to determine the organ index. Neutral red assay was performed to measure the peritoneal macrophage phagocytosis and XTT assay was used to detect the concanavalin (ConA) - induced splenic lymphocyte proliferation in vitro. [Results] RGP ameliorated the swelling of mouse toes, and the indexes of the thymus and spleen. Dose-dependently elevated the lymphocyte proliferation responses and enhanced the peritoneal macrophage phagocytosis. [Conclusion] RGP plays a regulatory role in immune function of the mice by increasing the indexes of immune organs and ameliorating the swelling of mouse toes, increasing the lymphocyte proliferation responses and enhanced peritoneal macrophage phagocytosis.

articleTitle: Study of Application of Multimedia Technology in English Language Teaching
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The application of multimedia technology in English language teaching is an important theoretical and practical issue. In this paper, the rational proposals have been paid attention to in the application of using multimedia technology in English language teaching based on the problems of present situation of college English language teaching, in order to improve the teaching quality and effect of English linguistics course in universities.

articleTitle: Study on the Japan's Animation Technology by Internet Based on Japanese Traditional Culture
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The internet has become widely ways with which Japan's animation technology in China, but animation culture and production techniques have not been paid as much as it was concerned. In this paper, the Japan culture and animation software were introduced in order to enhance the animation production level.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Solution of Quantum Hydrodynamic Model for Semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: A class of quantum hydrodynamic model of steady-state bipolar semiconductor equation with viscous term is discussed in this paper. This model contains third-order quantum correction and second order viscous term. There is little discussion on the bipolar model. This paper considers a class of bipolar quantum hydrodynamics equations with a special viscous term. We prove that, in the case of isothermal or isentropic, the equations have a positive solution for all current density.

articleTitle: The Ability of University Teaching Staff in the New Period
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In today's world, knowledge-based economy, information, network, globalization, and the competition of science and technology have become more and more fierce, so the key position of higher education is becoming more and more prominent. The main task of the institutions of higher school is to cultivate talent, and the teaching is the central work in Colleges and universities, teaching and educational administration is the basis of guaranteeing teaching order and promoting quality of running school, is one of the key links in the management of colleges and universities. Therefore, how to improve the quality of education, offer better quality education, professional knowledge and skills for students, rich their wings and help them do some preparation for students to really move toward society are required profound thinking for university staff. In this paper, it analyzes some deficiencies of the educational administration departments and summarizes some proposals in order to achieve better education in the identity of the staff of the university educational administration department.

articleTitle: Effect of Packaging on Quality and Flavor of Fresh-Cut Mint
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The effect of packaging on the quality of fresh-cut mint was evaluated. The shelf life of the fresh-cut mint was up to 12 d. The 1-MCP and modified atmosphere package treatments showed no significant influence on the total micorflora count, sensory features, and flavor of the fresh-cut mint. Remarkably, the modified atmosphere package treatment held the chlorophyll content and greenness of the mint. Hence, the modified atmosphere package treatment benefited the storage of the fresh-cut mint.

articleTitle: Research Hotspots Analysis of Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder by PubMed
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To understand the research hotspots of Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) by PubMed. Methods: With MS Excel, SPSS, Cytoscape software, we took MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) word frequency analysis, clustering analysis, co-word network graph of PubMed papers. Results: By MeSH of 11873 papers analyzed, it shows that the current ADHD research hotspots had focused on "Central Nervous System Stimulants, Methylphenidate, Attention, Brain, Cognition Disorders, Mental Disorders, Propylamines, Adrenergic Uptake Inhibitors, Substance-Related Disorders", etc, it also suggests that the most importance of which was Central Nervous System Stimulants. Conclusion: With multi-angle analysis of bibliometrics, we understand the outline of research hotspots about ADHD. It is helpful and time saving for the researcher or doctor to understand the research hotspots in ADHD.

articleTitle: A CRF-based Method for Automatic Construction of Chinese Symptom Lexicon
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Lexicon plays a key role in Medical Language Processing (MLP) technology. Construction of semantic lexicon has become the prerequisite of MLP study in China where there are limited clinical terminology resources available. In this study, an iterative machine learning algorithm based on Conditional Random Field (CRF) was proposed aiming to automatically build a symptom lexicon from clinical corpus. Comprehensive evaluation was conducted in terms of exact and inexact for the algorithm. The algorithm achieved the performance, with F-measure of 87.23%, precision and recall were 99.95% and 72.23%, respectively. Furthermore, a lexicon which contained 22,501 symptoms was constructed based on this approach.

articleTitle: The Application Research of Science and Technology Activities Month in the Cultivation of College Students' Innovative Practical Ability
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The cultivation of innovative practical ability of college students is an important part of higher education. How to solve the problems existing in the current college students' scientific and technological activities effectively is an important way to improve the practical level of college students. Through analyzing the current situation of college students' scientific and technological innovation activities, this paper put forward the activity plan and implementation process of our college' science and technology activities month, which based on our college' talents training mode of "widening foundation, master theory, pay attention to practice and strengthen ability", with the theme of "improve the professional quality, achieve teachers and students dream", and shows the effect and experience of the science and technology activities month. Through activity practice shows that the activity of science and technology month has improved the students' ability of innovation and practice, and enhanced the competitiveness of graduates, and achieved good activity effect, which provided good ideas and methods to solve the problems of college students' scientific and technological innovation.

articleTitle: Research Hotspots Analysis of Advanced Aged Patients Fracture Treatment by PubMed
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To understand the research hotspots of advanced aged patients (Over 80 - year -- old) fracture treatment by PubMed. Methods: With MS Excel, SPSS, Cytoscape software, we took MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) word frequency analysis, clustering analysis, co-word network graph of PubMed papers. Results: By MeSH of 10803 papers analyzed, it shows that the current advanced aged patients fracture treatment research hotspots had focused on "Hip Fractures, Fracture Fixation, Internal, Femoral Neck Fractures, Spinal Fractures, Femoral Fractures, Fracture Fixation, Intramedullary, Bone Plates, Bone Nails, Bone Screws", etc, it also suggests that the most top 2 importance of which was "Hip Fractures" and "Fracture Fixation, Internal". Conclusion: With multi-angle analysis of bibliometrics, we understand the outline of research hotspots about advanced aged patients fracture treatment. It is helpful and time saving for the researcher or doctor to understand the research hotspots in advanced aged patients fracture treatment.

articleTitle: Research Hotspots Analysis of Geriatric Nurse by PubMed
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To outline the research hotspots of geriatric nurse by PubMed. Methods: With MS Excel, SPSS, Cytoscape software, we took MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) word frequency analysis, clustering analysis, co-word network graph of PubMed papers. Results: It shows that the current geriatric nurse research hotspots had focus on "Attitude of Health Personnel, Nurse Practitioners, Geriatric Nursing, Nurse Clinicians, Primary Health Care, Nursing Homes, Nurse Administrators", etc, it also suggests that the most top 2 importance of which was "Attitude of Health Personnel" and "Nurse Clinicians". Conclusion: It is helpful and timesaving for researcher or doctor to understand the research hotspots in geriatric nurse.

articleTitle: A Research of Medical Undergraduates on Autonomous Learning Measurement and Self-Efficacy
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To revise the autonomous learning scale that developed by Michigan State University for its applicability in Chinese, and to explore the relationship between self-efficacy and autonomous learning of medical undergraduates. Methods: The general self-efficacy scale and autonomous learning scale are used to measure the medical undergraduates. Results: (1) The scale revised of autonomic learning can be divided into two dimensions that cognitive strategy and motivated belief, the former contains two factors that organization strategy and rehearsal strategy, the later contains two factors that self-efficacy and values, (2) There is a difference in values factor score for medical undergraduates of different gender, There are significant differences in all dimensions for medical undergraduates from different regions, Under the test variable that one child or not, there are significant differences for medical undergraduates in all dimensions except for the values factor, There are differences for different school year medical undergraduates in scores of motivation beliefs, rehearsal strategies, self-efficacy and values, (3) There are significant correlations among self-efficacy and autonomous learning strategies along with its various dimensions and factors. Conclusion: Self-efficacy is associated with autonomous learning.

articleTitle: The Application of E-Learning System Based on the Network Teaching Platform in Microbiology and Parasitology Teaching
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Nowadays the Internet technology has changed our life and the modes of our work and study. Under this condition, electric-learning (e-learning) will become a principal pathway of obtaining knowledge for basically medical education. To investigate the effects of the e-learning system on the microbiology and parasitology studying, we gave the teaching of microbiology and parasitology with the e-learning system for the past three years. The results showed that more than 90% students thought the e-learning system was helpful and especially for the personalized learning. The excellent rate had been improved greatly. It may be more suitable for the practical class.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Teaching Evaluation System Based on Web
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Teaching quality value is the key point in valuing teaching quality in universities. This paper introduces the model design and evaluation index, web design and work flow, etc, and it is combined with Teaching Evaluation System (TES) of the Yuxi Normal University. It can remedy the defects in traditional teaching evaluation. Now the TES has been adopted in practice and the results show that it can not only improve work efficiency, easy and visual to operate, but also has good stability, maintainability and expansibility.

articleTitle: Research Hotspots Analysis of Myocardial Infarction and Biomarker by PubMed
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To understand the research hotspots of myocardial infarction and biomarker by PubMed. Methods: With MS Excel, SPSS, Cytoscape software, we took MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) word frequency analysis, clustering analysis, co-word network graph of PubMed papers. Results: It shows that the current myocardial infarction and biomarker research hotspots had focus on "Troponin, Unstable Angina, Angioplasty, C-Reactive Protein", etc, it also suggests that the most importance of which was "Troponin". Conclusion: It is helpful and timesaving for researcher or doctor to understand the research hotspots in myocardial infarction and biomarker.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influencing Factors of Elective Surgery Cancellation
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: On account of the fact that surgery cancellation has tremendously affected the operational efficiency of the operating room, an exploration of such factors have exerted an influence on the cancellation emerges as an important and worthwhile research. After data preprocessing, one-way analysis of variance and chi-square test were used on 9 potential factors. By means of statistics method, we come to the conclusion that surgeons, sequence of surgery, number of days after admission, surgery rooms, and cancelled before have profound impacts on cancellation, while patient gender, patient age, day of week, anesthesia were irrelevant to cancellation. Finally, explanations were given and suggestion were made to decrease the cancellation rate and to improve the efficiency of the operating room.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis Study on Flow Field and Sound Field in Spiral Tube
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The model of Realizable κ-ε in fluent of computational fluid dynamics software was used to numerically simulate unsteady turbulent flow in spiral tube. In order to get the sound pressure with time variation diagram and the sound field spectrogram, the situation of flow field was analyzed and the acoustic field was monitored by the FW-H equation. The results show that the pressure of fluid to the internal wall was changing continually with time in the flow field. They were given that the cross section which can produce relatively large turbulent kinetic energy, and the relationships between the spiral angle θ and turbulent kinetic energy, speed. It was found that the sound pressure in sound field increased with time, reached the extreme value and then leveled out. The sound pressure level gradually decreased with the increase of frequency. These results provide an important theoretical basis for the optimization and design of spiral pipe.

articleTitle: A Video Recording System for the Inheritance of TCMS
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Face to face hand-holding is the main Inheritance method of traditional Chinese medical science (TCMS). But famous traditional-Chinese doctors are very rare, it's almost impossible to learn face-to-face for the youth who are thirsty for traditional Chinese diagnosis. In order to resolve the contradiction, this paper develops a video recording system to record the diagnostic procedure of famous traditional Chinese doctors, in which full views have been recorded as mp4 files which would be played again and again and stored forever in Weblib server. Also a mechanism for reliable recording and synchronization is proposed and implemented in the system.

articleTitle: Research Hotspots Analysis of Psychological Nursing by PubMed
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To understand the research hotspots of psychological nursing by PubMed. Methods: With MS Excel, SPSS, Cytoscape software, we took MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) word frequency analysis, clustering analysis, co-word network graph of PubMed papers. Results: By MeSH of 15410 papers analyzed, it shows that the current psychological nursing research hotspots had focused on "Attitude of Health Personnel, Nurse Administrators, Nurse's Role, Leadership, Stress, Psychological, Interprofessional Relations", etc, it also suggests that the most importance of which was "Attitude of Health Personnel". Conclusion: With multi-angle analysis of bibliometrics, we understand the outline of research hotspots about psychological nursing. It is helpful and time saving for the researcher or doctor to understand the research hotspots in psychological nursing.

articleTitle: Bioinformatics Analysis of Integrin aVß3
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Integrins are cell adhesion molecules that mediate cell-cell, cell-extracellular matrix, and cell-pathogen interaction. They play critical roles in leukocyte trafficking, migration, immunological synapse formation, costimulation, and phagocytosis. The studies of integrin structure and function help us better understanding the various pathological processes such as chronic inflammation, thrombosis and cancer metastasis. They are also significant in designing related anti-inflammatory and anti-tumor drugs. A variety of methods of bioinformatics softwares are used to analyze their protein sequences, structure, the basic chemical property of the primary structure, the secondary structure of the protein sequence and the tertiary structure of the protein homology modeling. The different evolutionary relationship of av ß subunit and ß3 subunit in different species will be also learned. After that, the biological pathways related integrin av ß3 will be mainly analyzed, to find detailed integrin avß3 pathways and the key members. This research deepens our understanding about the structure and functions of integrin av ß3, providing new insight into the treatment of related diseases.

articleTitle: An Agglomerative Hierarchical Clustering Algorithm Based on Global Distance Measurement
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The accuracy of existing hierarchical clustering algorithms in distance measurement is not high, in order to improve it, this paper proposes a condensing hierarchical clustering algorithm based on global distance measurement. This method puts forward the concept of global distance and local distance for the distance measurement, effectively depicting the distance between the data objects, in the merger of the clusters, it also proposes two new concepts: the cohesion within the class and the separability between classes, at the same time, on the basis of these two concepts, it constructs an objective function and maximizes the objective function to reach the purpose that the cohesion within the class be as large as possible, the separability between classes be as small as possible, in order to obtain the optimal clustering results. The experimental accuracy of this algorithm is higher than traditional hierarchical clustering algorithms both on the artificial data and real data sets, which shows that the algorithm has higher clustering validity.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Statistics Software in the Research on University Teachers' Organizational Identification
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Organizational identification is a perception that individual is consistent with the organization. The purpose of this paper was to explore the status of university teachers' organizational identification and the influencing factors by applying the computational statistics software SPSS19.0 to analyze the data. Method: 535 university teachers were investigated with two questionnaires and the data were tested with the correlation analysis, F test and regression analysis. Results: Firstly, the retest reliability and the Cranach's reliability of the self-compiled organizational identification's questionnaire were 0.85 and 0.89 respectively, which completely meet the psychometric requirements. Secondly, University teachers' organizational identification was in the middle level and there are significant differences in seniority, and title variable, except for the gender variable. In addition, the personality traits of psychoticism and neuroticism could negatively predict the level of university teachers' organizational identification. Finally, according to the results and analysis of this research, we put forward three proposals and countermeasures to improve college teachers' organizational identity.

articleTitle: Comparison of Proton Beam and Photons Beam in the Radiotherapy of NPC
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Purpose: In radiotherapy of the nasopharyngeal carcinoma, the randomized controlled trials of proton and photon therapy treatment is less. The purpose of this paper is to evaluate the dosimetry superiority of the proton beam and photons beam for NPC. Method: Clinical trails of dosimetry comparison between proton beam and photons beam for NPC are retrieved from the PubMed, Cochrane Library, Medline, CNKI, WFD, UCDRS, SinoMed. Results: three literatures were included in this study, through the comparison of proton therapy and intensity modulated radiation therapy. Spinal cord (MD=-4.14, 95%CI: -6.37, -1.91, P=0.0003); Brainstem (MD=-14.84, 95%CI: -21.76, -7.92, P<;0.0001); Ipsilateral parotid gland (MD=-6.38, 95%CI: -8.27, -4.50, P<;0.00001); Contralateral parotid gland (MD=-6.37, 95%CI: -7.31, -5.42, P<;0.00001). Conclusion: Compared with the traditional photon radiation therapy, proton therapy has obvious advantage in reducing dose of the organs at risk.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Data Modeling and Integration Based on Metadata
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: As various institutions' information management systems rely on heterogeneous data, these systems normally cannot share data inducing many information islands. In order to integrate various information management systems, a metadata-based data modeling and integration solution is proposed. First, we established a technical metadata model based on Shandong University information system platform, and built the business metadata model from other individual subservice systems. Second, we constructed business model and abstracted data integration operation into platform-independent model. XML was adopted to describe the details and contents, Additionally, MDA was leveraged to reduce the operating difficulty and improve the reusability. The proposed framework was implemented with Java EE. Experiments show that the proposed framework can efficiently integrate heterogeneous data.

articleTitle: Application of Web Based Course on Case Based Learning in Prosthodontics Teaching
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to evaluate the results of Web Based Course on Case Based Learning (CBL) in the Prosthodontics Teaching. In the study, web based prosthodontics course with CBL method was applied to a group of students. And prosthodontics course with traditional teaching method was applied to another group of students. After the course, a questionnaire and an exam were fulfilled by each student. The questionnaire also included the participants attitudes toward the challenges through Web Based CBL course and the suggestion of the education reform.The results showed that there was statistically significant difference on the average scores between 2 groups of students (p<;0.05). The average scores of web based course on CBL (87.1 ± 3.87) is statistically significant higher than those of the traditional teaching method (81.3±4.11). In a word, the web based CBL course showed advanced and scientific advantages in prosthodontics teaching.

articleTitle: Research and Design on Opening Laboratory Reservation System
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: University laboratory is very important place for teaching and scientific research. Our approach is to build the system on the campus network, and use the C/S-B/S model. Now the Opening Laboratory Reservation System (OLRS) has been adopted in practice and the results show that it can not only improve work efficiency and the utilization of equipment, save resources easy and visual to operate, but also has good stability, security and expansibility.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Art Teaching Module Based on Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Internet is an attractive cultural exchange platform in the intelligent art teaching module, particularly for foreigner which are difficult to understanding cultural background. The process the traditional teaching system is suited to native culture background but because of the long time required, conventional Education facilities would require excessive student carrying capacity. The intelligent art teaching modules in the network environment has been developed. Together with associated hardware system improvements, increased suitability of the language learners have been demonstrated for the learning effect of using and relay.

articleTitle: Comrehensive Comparisons of High Efficient Localization Algorithms in WSN
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In our papers before, two three-dimensional localization schemes which are called iterative calculation of secondary grid division localization scheme (ICSGD) and an improved node self-localization algorithm based on virtual central node for WSNs which is called IVCN are proposed respectively. In ICSGDLS scheme, forty beacon nodes and five hundred unknown sensor nodes is randomly deployed in a cube, which is divided into smaller cubes twice. The position information of unknown nodes could be got by iteratively calculating the centroid of the smaller cubes. However in IVCN algorithm, localization problem is solved by deducing a 3D special node that is called virtual central node (VCN) from three different anchor nodes and the deducing process is more simplified. The unknown position coordinates can be obtained by the whole four-node position information finally. In this paper, comprehensive analysis and comparisons are made by MATLAB software. And in this paper we can find the optimum work status of the two.

Author Keywords: Iterative Calculation of Secondary Grid Division (ICSGD)

articleTitle: Detection and Evaluation of GABA Concentration in Anterior Cingulate Cortex and Occipital Cortex by MEGA-PRESS
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Glutamate (Glu) and gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) are very important neurotransmitters. They play critical roles in mental illness such as depression and schizophrenia. However, neurological bases and mechanisms of GABA for quantifying specific diseases or characterizing regional neural function remain poorly understood. In this study, MEGA-PRESS sequence was used to study the GABA concentration in brain regions of anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) and occipital cortex (OCC) from 14 healthy volunteers (7 females). The concentration of GABA+ in OCC was higher than that in ACC, revealing a region-specific feature (p = 0.001). An obvious linear regression was manifested between GM tissue ratio and GABA+ in OCC (correlation coefficient R2: 0.467, p

articleTitle: Sleep Deprivation Increased Dopamine D2 Receptor Expression through Downregulation of miR-9
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Sleep-wake cycle is a complex process relates to a variety of neurotransmitters and receptors in the central nervous system (CNS), also involves a large number of gene transcription and translation. MicroRNAs (miRNAs) have emerged as important regulators of gene expression, which mediate translational repression and/or mRNA decay of a target gene. Dopamine D2 receptor (DRD2) gene is predicted as a target gene of a brain-enriched miRNA, miR-9, but their functions in sleep-wake cycle remain unknown. In this study, we reported that REM sleep deprivation decreases the level of miR-9 and this induction is associated with the expression of DRD2 proteins. Thus, miR-9 may control DRD2 gene translation in the prefrontal cortex for processing sleep deprivation. Our findings may have implications in understanding the biological relevance of the genetic associations of sleep disorders. Furthermore, miR-9 may be considered as potential drug targets for the treatment of disorders involving abnormal DRD2 function, such as insomnia.

articleTitle: Study on the Feasibility of Using a Chinese Character Writing Scale to Distinguish Amnestic-MCI
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The purpose of this paper was to utilize the Chinese Character Writing Scale (CCWS) to identify patients with amnestic mild cognitive impairment (a-MCI) from healthy and Alzheimer's disease (AD) patients. Thirty-five cases were collected, including 11 patients with AD (AD group), 11 patients with a-MCI (a-MCI group), and 13 normal controls (NC group). The scores of the CCWS for different groups were evaluated by the physicians, then used to distinguish a-MCI from NC and AD. The ability of the CCWS to distinguish a-MCI was compared with other scales used clinically, such as the methods of the Alzheimer's Disease Assessment Scale (ADAS) and the Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE). The results was as follows: (1) the classification accuracy based on the CCWS on distinguishing a-MCI from NC is greater than the MMSE and ADAS, (2) age and level of education had little effect on the classification accuracy of either scale on distinguishing a-MCI from NC. These experimental results indicate that using the CCWS to distinguish a-MCI is feasible.

articleTitle: Research of Data Sharing between Applications Base on User Request
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper presents an implementation for data sharing between applications based on asymmetric encryption algorithms, digital signature. It also provides a new idea of data sharing between applications. It can be a supplementary program for data sharing. It can be an effective solution to solve the problem of sensitive personal data grant between applications data and can be used for proof of personal income data, statistical data sharing and the like.

articleTitle: Research on Life-Oriented Teaching Situation with Multimedia in Ideological and Political Education
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Creating and applying life-oriented situation in classroom teaching has become an effective teaching method of ideological and political teaching. This paper interprets the connotation of life-oriented teaching situation, analyzes the characteristics of the life-oriented situation of ideological and political teaching, and introduces three approaches of creating life-oriented teaching situation with multimedia application, with the objective of exploring new paths ideological and political education and providing some enlightenment.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Clinical Data Center Based on Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper considers the actual needs of the hospital for data storage and the characteristics of the Hadoop framework, builds a clinical data center using Hadoop, Hive and so on which are widely used in modern society. This new clinical data center overcomes the shortcomings of traditional Unix servers, meets the hospital demand for data storage and provides Cloud Computing platform. First, this paper describes the current trends of hospital clinical data center. Then the paper describes the design of clinical data center with EMR and PACS and realizes the storage of structured data and unstructured data.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis on the Experimental SNP Data Based on Neutral Theory
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To explore the statistical properties of experimental SNP data, a large number of experimental DNA samples from five populations (Africa, America, Europe, East Asia and South Asia) were subjected to statistical analysis in this paper. We classified the SNPs into different types based on the frequency of their minor alleles in the sample. The results show that the relationship between the number of different types of SNPs and the frequency of their minor alleles in the sample are very similar to the theoretical inferences and can be expressed by a power function. All of the populations carry excesses of very rare SNPs compared with the expectation, which reflects recent explosive increases in population size. Compare with other populations, the excessive very rare SNPs of America extends to a higher frequency, which reflects a relatively earlier start time of the recent explosive increases in population size. This finding is probably due to the region being far away from the battlefields of the First World War and Second World War. That the non-Africa populations carry excesses of high-frequency SNPs is an obvious sign of the founder effect, which indicates that the results are consistent with the Out of Africa hypothesis.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Endoscopic-Assisted Neck Minimally Invasive Radical Operation of Thyroid Cancer (Experience of 402 Cases)
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The endoscopic-assisted neck minimally invasive thyroid surgery is one of the main directions of development of thyroid surgery in recent years. To retrospectively analyze clinical data of 402 cases (327 women and 75 men with a mean age of 44 years) of endoscopic-assisted neck minimally invasive radical operation of thyroid cancer in The First Hospital of Jilin University in China from January, 2007 to May, 2015. The operation was performed under general anesthesia and tracheal intubation, and the Miccoli's technique was performed during the surgery. 381 patients were successfully operated by endoscopic-assisted neck minimally invasive radical operation of thyroid cancer. 21 cases transferred to open surgery because of extensive adhesion of tumor or uncontrollable bleeding. All cases had no postoperative bleeding or infection. Normal endocrine suppression therapy were offered after operation and some patients were undergone the treatment of I131. The whole group were followed up for 1 to 36 months, no recurrences happened. Endoscopic-assisted neck minimally invasive radical operation of differentiated thyroid cancer is a practical, low invasive surgery, which has advantages of safety, reliability, less bleeding, less pain, shorter hospital stay, fewer complications and relative cosmetic results. On the basis of mastering certain skills, it has better clinical effects and brighter application prospect.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Internet Multimedia Technology in Applied Linguistics Teaching
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the progress of science and technology, the audio tools were applied to applied linguistics teaching in applied linguistics teaching modernization. Internet multimedia technology has been applied in applied linguistics teaching is very necessary. Application results show that the application of internet multimedia technology can snake the student snore easy to learn applied linguistics, more easy to applied linguistics development.

articleTitle: Development of HSK System for Chinese Language and Literature Based on Internet Platform
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's economy and the need of depth international exchange, the HSK system combination of Internet and Chinese language is the expression of following the trend of the times. The internet online platform was used to secondary development is an innovation, a new level and a new develop method. In this paper, the internet online platform was proposed in order to exam level of foreign students in Chinese language and literature.

articleTitle: Exact Image Reconstruction for Translation Based Tomography
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: New techniques for movable ultra-low-cost x-ray CT scanners are in instant and great needs for military, war areas, developing countries, and rural areas. In previous study, we proposed a novel CT scanning method which is based on the parallel translation of the tube/detectors. In other words, the popular slip ring is replaced by a translation based setup, and the instrumentation cost is reduced by a relaxation of the imaging speed requirement. In this paper, we furthered the exact image reconstruction algorithm for the translation based tomography scheme with two or more linear scans. The mathematical model is analyzed and the numerical simulations are conducted for different scans to validate the feasibility of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: MDCT Manifestations of Normal Sigmoid Mesocolon
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To investigate the multi-detector computed tomography (MDCT) manifestations of the normal sigmoid mesocolon. Methods: Fifty cases were studied to evaluate the 64-detector computed tomography appearances of the normal sigmoid mesocolon. Results: (1) The inferior mesenteric artery (IMA) and inferior mesenteric vein (IMV) were identified on axial, coronal and sagital MDCT images in 50 cases. The mesenteric vessels of the sigmoid mesocolon showed characteristic wavy appearances as they coursed through the mesenteric fat. (2) The mesenteric lymph nodes were not roundly identified on MDCT. The attenuation of the fat located within the sigmoid mesocolon was ranged from -80Hu to -115Hu. Conclusion: The IMA and IMV can be revealed readily on the MDCT images of normal individuals. Combining the axial, coronal and sagital MDCT images can easily demonstrate the sigmoid mesocolon.

articleTitle: The Effect of Nasal Septum Deviation on the New Technology of the Treatment of Maxillary Sinus Cyst
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objection: the research of The effect of nasal septum deviation on the new technology of the treatment of maxillary sinus cyst. Way: 61 patients with maxillary sinus cyst were selected from patients with CT scan, and were divided into two groups. Group one includes 32 patients with Maxillary sinus cyst(treatment group). Group two uses 29 Patients with nasal septum deviation of maxillary sinus cyst as a comparison(matched group). These two group Adopt the surface anesthesia or local anesthesia, Under the conventional via nasal passages or labial gingival sulcus second incisor puncture, let the needle get into the cyst and then extract the fluid. According to the number of the fluid, inject our invention patent medicine by the ratio of 2:1(the fluid was 2ml, the drug was 1ml, and the main component of the drug was the super oxidation of iodine atoms). After two months' treatment, taking the CT scan for the two groups' patients in order to observe their effect respectively. Results: the patients in treatment group were all cured by taking 1-2 times' new way. Among the matched group, 5 patients were cured and 25 patients get better. The cure rate and the effective rate of the treatment group and the control group have the statistically significance (p<;0.05, p<;0.01). conclusion: The research shows that the nasal septum is an important factor that affects the curative effect of the treatment of maxillary sinus cyst. Before treatment, the treatment and correction of nasal septum deviation should be first considered to provide ideas and methods for the comprehensive treatment of the relevant deviation of nasal septum, maxillary sinus cyst.

articleTitle: The Safety and Availability of Video-Assisted Modified Radical Neck Dissection in Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To evaluate the safety and availability of video-assisted modified radical neck dissection In papillary thyroid carcinoma. We retrospectively analyzed 77 cases of papillary thyroid carcinoma patients with video-assisted modified radical neck dissection from 2006.06.01 to 2015.05.01 at the thyroid surgery department of the First Hospital of Jilin University. 1n order to evaluate the safety and availability of this operation we analyzed statistically its complications and prognosis. 77 patients included in the study were divided into four groups by the surgical procedures as following: I. Only lateral neck dissection. II: Total thyroidectomy plus lateral neck dissection. m: Thyroidectomy plus central and lateral neck dissection. IV: Lateral plus central neck dissection. The average incidence ofpostoperative complications was 42.3%. The incidence of postoperative complications in groupmwas up to 58%, II group followed by up to 57.1%. The lowest incidence of complications in the group I was only 12.5%. Among complications, the temporary hypoparathyroidism was the most common (40.3%). No one case happened with permanent complications. No operative mortality. All four groups were followed up for 1 to 108 months. One case (1.3%) developed local recurrence. The video-assisted modified radical neck dissection in papillary thyroid carcinoma is safe and effective with less permanent complications. This operation does not only preserve the neck functions and retain notch beauty, but also does not reduce the safety and availability ofsurgical treatment. However, if with central neck dissection, especially in patients with total thyroidectomy, the incidence of complications will increase. The most common complication IS hypoparathyroidism, so intraoperative parathyroid protection IS particularly significant.

articleTitle: Exploration on the practice teaching of law major in Distance Education
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The practice teaching of law is a concept which is corresponding to the teaching of legal theory, and it is a kind of teaching method which aims at cultivating students' practical ability. Based on the professional characteristics of the legal profession, it is necessary to pay attention to the practical teaching link in the distance education of the legal profession. But in fact, there are many problems in the practice teaching in the distance education of the legal profession in our country. For example, the curriculum design of the practical teaching in the distance education is a mere formality, which is not consistent with the characteristics of the distance education, Legal practice teaching evaluation system is unreasonable, and so on. Therefore, we should explore the practical teaching mode of law major for the characteristics of distance education aim at these problems.

articleTitle: The Lipogenic Gene Expression of Mammary was Inhibited by CLA in Lactating Mice
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to test the lipogenic gene expression of mammary gland in lactating animal which received the CLA, mice are housed individually in polycarbonate cages. All animals were fed the laboratory chow diet for the first 3 d. On day 4 postpartum, six lactating mice were randomly assigned to the control group (2% Peanut oil) or low lever CLA groups (LL group,0.5% CLA +1.5% Peanut oil), median lever CLA group (ML group, 1%CLA+1% Peanut oil), high lever CLA group (HL group, 1.5%CLA+0.5% Peanut oil) from day 4 to 15 postpartum. The body weight and food intake of dam and body weight of pup was tested every day. The weight and composition of Milk were measured by the chemistry method. The mRNA expression of lipogenic gene was measured using real-time PCR. The results showed that dam body weight didn't changed through the testing period, but the food significantly decreased of HL group compared with control group(13.75 vs 19.45),After the intake of CLA food, The pups of HL group lost weight more rapidly, and from d 8 had significantly lower body weights than control pups (P

articleTitle: A BP Model of Evaluating On-Line Learning Subject Behavior
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: On-Line Learning Behavior depend on learning subject self-control learning, collaborative learning, and obtaining of support and help. Based on learning subject, the On-Line learning behavior need the real-time monitoring and the effective instruction to through the evaluation in the learning process. The BP algorithm model of evaluating E-Learning behavior selects the learning behavior which affects the study effect in network learning process, has established the network learning behavior evaluating indicator system, and takes the data-in by the second-level target, carries on the network training using MATLAB, In the network training process, the global error assumes the declining trend basically, the restraining effect is good. Through the test indicated that this model may use in evaluating the network learning behavior, and obtains the expectation effect.

articleTitle: Teaching Reform on Computer Operating System
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Based on the feature of the operating system course and the practice of teaching, the paper studies the existing problems in the teaching process. We propose improvements on four aspects: update teaching contents, improve teaching methods, strengthen practical teaching and reform the manner of examination. With the help of these improvements, the teaching practice shows that students' learning interest is obviously stimulated, and the teaching effect has been evidently improved.

articleTitle: Predicition of Three-Dimensional Structure of CTGF Protein
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To predict three-dimensional structure and binding site of ligand from amino acid sequence of peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gammaCTGF protein. The secondary structure and surface properties of CTGF protein such as hydrophilicity, physical and chemical properties, surface probability, flexible regions, motif, transmembrane domain, signal peptide and secondary structure were analyzed to predict its binding site of ligand by bioinformatics methods and means. Many potential bingding sites of ligand were identified. Conclusion: The secondary structure and bingding site of ligand of CTGF protein were predicted successfully by multiparameter. This study provided a foundation for identification of its advantage binding site of ligand and understanding its biological functions on the basis of protein structure.

articleTitle: Research Hotspots Analysis of Antihypertensive Agents (Pharmacological Action) by PubMed
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To understand the research hotspots of antihypertensive agents (pharmacological action) by PubMed. Methods: With MS Excel, SPSS, Cytoscape software, we took MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) word frequency analysis, clustering analysis, co-word network graph of PubMed papers. Results: It shows that the current antihypertensive agents (pharmacological action) research hotspots had focus on "Hypertension, Tetrazoles, Angiotensin II Type 1 Receptor Blockers, Propranolol, Adrenergic beta-Antagonists", etc, it also suggests that the most importance of which was Angiotensin II Type 1 Receptor Blockers. Conclusion: It is helpful and timesaving for researcher or doctor to understand the research hotspots in antihypertensive agents (pharmacological action).

articleTitle: A Comparison of the Pathologically Transmural and Electrical Isolation of Atrial Tissues after Once and Three Times of Bipolar Radiofrequency Ablation
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: A finite element model was developed to simulate the ablation results. The optimal parameters (30 w, 15 s) were obtained by changing the input energy (20 w, 25 w, 30 w, 35 w, 40 w) with different operating times (15 s, 20 s, 25 s, 30 s). Then, in vitro and in vivo experiments were performed based on the results from FEM simulation. In the in vitro experiments, 240 pieces of strips of tissues were equally divided into group A and group B, and group A was ablated once by bipolar RFA system while group B was ablated three times. After stained with Mason trichrome, the tissue was examined under the microscope to validate whether a pathologically transmural ablation was successfully achieved. In the in vivo experiments, 20 pigs were equally divided into group C and group D. Left pulmonary veins in Group C and left atrial appendages ablated once while the right pulmonary veins and atrial appendage were ablated three times, and left atrial were ablated once while their right atrial ablated three times in group D. The electrophysiological mapping was utilized to validate the electro physiologically transmural lesion. And after fed for 4 weeks, the second electrophysiological mapping was utilized to confirm the long-term electrical isolation. Pathologically transmural lesion was achieved in 51.67% and 98.33% of the atrial tissue in Group A and B respectively. Total immediate electrical isolation rate was 61.67% for once ablation, while it was 100% for three times of ablation. And the total long-term electrical isolation rate was 31.67% for once ablation, while it was 85% for three times of ablation. The results demonstrate that the three times of ablation can improve the rate of pathologically transmural and electrical isolation significantly.

articleTitle: A Game Analysis of Incentive Mechanism for Supervision over Rural Development Projects
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Beginning with information asymmetry between a development agency and its internal quality supervision department in the course of quality supervision over a rural development project, this paper analyzes the principal -- agent relationship between the development agency and its quality supervisors, as well as moral hazards which may arise from this relationship, and establishes a game model regarding the related incentive mechanism to find out the best incentive mechanism that the principal applies to the supervision agent and to define the incentive coefficient, with a view to incentivizing the supervision agent and effectively reducing the occurrence of moral hazards.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Research of Influence of Switching Costs on E-Loyalty under the B2C E-Commerce Environment
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to discuss the influence mechanism of customer loyalty from the angle of the switching costs, providing a theoretical basis for improving customer loyalty to B2C e-commerce enterprises. By drawing on previous studies on switching costs, combined with the characteristics of B2C e-commerce industry, we designed questionnaires and analyzed the data by using SPSS software. The results reveal that financial switching and relational switching cost has a significant impact on customer loyalty, among which relational switching cost is the biggest. Thus, we conclude that in making a plan to improve customer loyalty, enterprises should focus on perfecting measures of financial switching cost and relational switching cost, in particular related measures of relational switching costs.

articleTitle: Informal Learning Model Design Based on Micro-Blog
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Informal learning attracts more and more attention of people, as a new mobile Internet business, Mblog has some features such as immediate, mobility, personal, convenient and so on. So it is suitable for informal learning. Based on the background of Web2.0, this paper firstly analyzes the feasibility of constructing the informal learning mode by using micro-blog. Then it analyzes design principle of informal learning mode from four aspects: constructing learning team by classification, constructing learning content by collaboration, controlling information transmission systemic, and dominating learning environment. Finally we design Mblog-based informal learning mode.

articleTitle: Recombinant Plasmid of pPIC9K-afp84
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: Recombinant plasmid of pPIC9K-afp84. Methods: Afp84 gene was amplified by PCR and cloned into pUCm-T vector. Double enzyme digestion for the expression vector afp84 of pPIC9K gene in Pichia pastoris. Results: the target gene fragment was obtained by PCR amplification, and the recombinant plasmid pUCm-T and afp84 were obtained by pUCm-T-afp84 and afp84. Conclusion: eukaryotic expression vector pPIC9K-afp84 was successfully constructed, which is the basis for the expansion of the production scale and the nature and application of the antifreeze protein TmAFP84.

articleTitle: Research Hotspots Analysis of C-reactive Protein by PubMed

articleTitle: Java Teaching Reform Exploration Based on the Concept of CDIO Engineering
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Based on the latest international CDIO engineering education concept, the correspondence relationship between the four abilities of the Java language teaching target and the CDIO education project idea is analyzed. The Java teaching method based on CDIO engineering education idea is discussed. This teaching method is mainly from the aspects of theoretical teaching, experimental teaching and curriculum assessment to explore the Java language teaching mode. In order to improve the quality of teaching, so that students can not only become a programmer with skilled use of Java language, but also to improve the quality of a software engineer.

articleTitle: Research Hotspots Analysis of Insulin by PubMed
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To understand the research hotspots of insulin by PubMed. articleTitle: The Development of Multimedia in Foreign Linguistics Teaching for Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Multimedia technology is the most typical application examples for the computer information management system, which has been widely applied to the field of foreign linguistics teaching. How to use multimedia tools, allocate the multimedia technology and seek for benefit is one of the measures which every education department has to take. In this paper, t he application of CIMS in the foreign linguistics teaching for higher education has been applied. The results show that the teaching effectiveness has improved significantly in foreign linguistics.

articleTitle: Network Course Construction of Participant Demonstration Experiment: Taking Civil Engineering Experiment as Example
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Limited by the real experiment teaching condition, it becomes an inevitable choice to carry out the online experiment teaching for modern distance higher education in the present stage in China, and this requires China's modern distance higher education to construct the experiment network courses. According to the problems of the students' lower participation in the demonstration experiment, the higher development cost and longer development cycle of the virtual experiment and the remote control experiment, this paper puts forward the type of participant demonstration experiment, which not only requires the students to view the experimental process and phenomena, but also requires the students to read, record and process the experimental data, and finally complete the experiment report. Moreover, this paper mainly introduces the situation that modern distance education of Dalian University of Technology constructs the network course of civil engineering participant demonstration experiment, and the aim is to provide a reference for the construction of experiment network courses.

articleTitle: Research Hotspots Analysis of Osteoporosis by PubMed
publicationTitle: 2015 7th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
